scope: Appearance concept only. Does not change abilities or current pet assets.
rules: Six appearances per pet: levels 0 through 5.
Preserve face, species, coat/scale color, body proportions and identifiable silhouette at every level.
Each level adds a visible accessory or upgrades an existing accessory; do not scatter more gemstones everywhere.
Keep face, ears, horns, wings, paws and tail readable with safe margins.
Draw the same body pose and canvas anchor for every level; accessories never change collision size.
One shared base drawing plus aligned transparent accessory layers; export precomposed WebP for arena/UI.
Arena variants must read at 48-64 pixels; large portraits may retain secondary embroidery.
Level 5 may have a restrained static highlight; any animation is optional and respects reduced motion.
Show current level consistently in development, lobby and arena. Only preview future appearances in the development UI.
